concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-point-of-sale-shopper-engagement-shopper-input-amount]] — 2026-09-15 Terminal API Device/Input GetAmount guide for terminal decimal entry, currency display, timeout/Cancel/Busy outcomes and merchant validation before further use.
